reviews.title: No longer old videos
reviews.text:
What happened to many of us happened to me too. A lot of us had memories saved, videos from around 2020, and they don’t show up for me in any way. I still have access to the account, but if I search for my account from another account, it’s like my account never existed.

I think that was one of the biggest mistakes they made. I don’t think they considered that people still wanted to recover their memories from when they were younger. Now that that’s happened, I don’t really see a reason to keep an account or even have the app. The only reason I kept it was because of those memories, and now they’re gone. Honestly, it’s such a shame that those memories just disappeared overnight.
